content.title: HCAT Q2 Deep Dive: Medicaid Cuts Pressure Guidance, Profitability Initiatives Take Center Stage
content.summary: Healthcare software provider Health Catalyst (NASDAQ:HCAT) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 6.3% year on year to $80.72 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $75 million was less impressive, coming in 12% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.04 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
